t: At dawn I walk the camp and ask the sentries what they truly fear.
I sit with Liu Bei over the afternoon meal and ask what he will promise first.
By lamplight I ask Liu Bei why he still refuses to take what is not his.
sg-001.b: I ask who among his followers doubts him the most.
sg-001.c: I offer to carry his message to the nearest magistrate.

t: In the morning council I watch which officers Cao Cao lets speak first.
I follow Cao Cao through the afternoon inspection and note what he checks himself.
At night I ask Cao Cao what he would burn to keep the realm whole.
sg-002.b: I ask him bluntly what he expects from a new adviser.
sg-002.c: I review the supply ledgers before offering any opinion.

t: At first light I check the road ahead for the pass he will cross today.
In the afternoon heat I ask Guan Yu why he keeps the oath nobody asked of him.
By the night fire I ask Guan Yu what he would refuse even for his brother.
sg-003.b: I offer to scout the next pass before he rides in.
sg-003.c: I ask what the guards at the gate are really protecting.

t: In the morning mist I knock at the thatched door and state my business plainly.
Over afternoon tea I ask Zhuge Liang to show me the map on his wall.
Under the night sky I ask Zhuge Liang what he sees in the stars about me.
sg-004.b: I ask what he believes one adviser can really change.
sg-004.c: I ask whether he has already decided to leave the mountains.

t: In the morning drill yard I ask Zhou Yu how many ships he can trust.
In the afternoon I bring Zhou Yu the river charts and point at the weak bend.
By night I ask Zhou Yu whether he can play for me while I watch the water.
sg-005.b: I ask what the rival across the river already knows about him.
sg-005.c: I suggest we test the fire plan on a single boat.

t: At dawn I ask Lü Bu to let me ride beside the red horse.
In the afternoon I ask Lü Bu whose banner he would carry if he had to choose.
At night I ask Lü Bu who he truly trusts when the tent is empty.
sg-006.b: I warn him that his last ally is counting his betrayals.
sg-006.c: I offer him a promise and watch how he receives it.

t: In the quiet of morning I walk the palace corridor with Diaochan and ask who is watching us.
In the afternoon garden I ask Diaochan what part of this plan was never hers.
Under lantern light I ask Diaochan what she would do if no one gave her orders.
sg-007.b: I ask her to teach me what she has learned from the court.
sg-007.c: I offer to deliver her message so she is not seen.

t: At first light I check the child's cloak and the road behind us.
In the afternoon I ask Zhao Yun where he plans to break through the lines.
At dusk I ask Zhao Yun what keeps his hand steady on the spear.
sg-008.b: I ask him to tell me the safest hand signal before we ride.
sg-008.c: I offer to draw the pursuers away while he escapes.

t: In the morning hush I open the grimoire in the empty library and read the first line aloud.
In the afternoon I ask the grimoire what the entrance exam will cost me.
By candlelight I copy the grimoire's strange question and decide whom to ask.
story-001.b: I check the academy records for the day my magic was erased.
story-001.c: I ask the grimoire who else has read it before me.

t: On the first morning I introduce myself to Class Zero before the bell.
In the afternoon I watch each classmate practice and note which rule they break.
In the evening I ask Rin what the schedule on the board really means.
story-002.b: I ask Rin why a failed prodigy was assigned here.
story-002.c: I search the classroom for the list with our names.

t: At breakfast I ask Elise how she knew I would trip on the stairs.
In the afternoon I corner Elise after class and ask which disaster comes next.
After dark I follow Elise to see where she goes alone.
story-003.b: I ask her to name the duel she is trying to prevent.
story-003.c: I check the duel roster for my name.

t: In the morning light I read the admission letter again and look for the eclipse date.
In the afternoon I ask the first teacher I meet who they think I am.
At night I ask Noa about the student whose seat is supposedly mine.
story-004.b: I search the dormitory register for my name.
story-004.c: I compare how two teachers describe me.

t: In the morning I offer Mira a fresh start on her first spell lesson.
In the afternoon I ask Mira to show me exactly how her miracle fails.
In the evening I ask Mira to write down the words she hears when it works.
story-005.b: I ask her who taught her to pray before she could cast.
story-005.c: I look in the restricted shelf for the forbidden language.

t: In the morning I read the patron's first letter and ask Vesper why he chose me.
In the afternoon I ask Vesper what I should watch for in the future hero.
By night I ask Vesper what happens if my monthly report is late.
story-006.b: I ask who else is on his payroll at the academy.
story-006.c: I introduce myself to the future hero as a classmate.

t: At dawn I step onto the frozen lake and look for the staircase.
In the afternoon I descend and ask Iona which memory the academy will take first.
At night I ask Iona how I will know which memory I have given away.
story-007.b: I ask Iona why the lake academy needs memories.
story-007.c: I write a list of what I want to remember before I go down.

t: In the morning I check the summoning circle and ask the tiny creature what it wants.
In the afternoon I ask Theo whether the seal on the creature is real.
In the evening I feed the creature and watch what it does with the food.
story-008.b: I bring the creature to the examiner and ask for the rules.
story-008.c: I read the prophecy and look for a way to change one word.

t: In the morning I stand before the portrait and compare it with my memory.
In the afternoon I ask Sera who the honors hall used to celebrate.
At night I sit beside the portrait and wait for it to change.
story-009.b: I ask the registrar whether my name is still on the rolls.
story-009.c: I photograph the portrait every hour to prove it moves.

t: On the morning shift I check the ruined battlefield for what the report left out.
In the afternoon I ask Jace why the victory was cleaned up so quickly.
At night I compare the cleanup log with the official hero report.
story-010.b: I ask my team who signed the order for today's rescue.
story-010.c: I keep a spare copy of the evidence where nobody will look.

t: In the morning I thank Lune and ask who lost the day she borrowed.
In the afternoon I ask Lune how she picks the day she steals.
At night I ask Lune what happens when the collectors arrive.
story-011.b: I ask the collectors what exactly I owe.
story-011.c: I offer to take back one day for the person who lost it.

t: In the morning I check the club photo for the date nobody explains.
In the afternoon I ask Ada which urban legend we should investigate next.
After the evening meeting I ask Ada why the date keeps appearing.
story-012.b: I ask the club president who took the photograph.
story-012.c: I suggest we skip the next case until we understand the date.

t: In the morning lecture I ask Professor Vale why he assigned this case.
In the afternoon I read the condemned person's file and note what is missing.
In the evening I ask Professor Vale what he would do in my place.
story-013.b: I ask which classmate had access to the evidence.
story-013.c: I visit the condemned person before the hearing.

t: At dawn I find Celia on the practice field and ask her about the duel.
In the afternoon I ask Celia what she would do if she lost.
At night I search the archive for what the academy does with losers.
story-014.b: I ask the other duelist for her side.
story-014.c: I look for earlier duels and trace where the losers went.

t: In the morning I tell Ariel her halo is showing and offer her a scarf.
In the afternoon I ask Ariel what prayer she came to find.
In the evening I ask Ariel why she picked me to confide in.
story-015.b: I help her hide the halo during class.
story-015.c: I ask what the missing prayer said.

t: In the morning I read the will and ask the clerk how a debt can be inherited.
In the afternoon I visit the first creditor and ask what they claim.
At night I study the ledger by candlelight for the hero's last quest.
story-016.b: I ask the creditors who gave the hero the loan.
story-016.c: I look for the hero's companions to ask what they remember.

t: In the morning I open the shutters and ask the first guest where they are headed.
In the afternoon I inspect the rooms and ask who booked the last one.
At night I wait in the lobby and watch the room the abyss booked.
story-017.b: I check the guest register for names I do not recognise.
story-017.c: I ask the cook which guests never come downstairs.

t: At sunrise I study the mountain route and ask the postmaster who rode it last.
In the afternoon I ask the postmaster why the dragon's letter was never delivered.
At dusk I read the dragon's address and decide whether to open the letter.
story-018.b: I ask how the previous rider disappeared.
story-018.c: I pack the letter and the supplies and start climbing.

t: In the morning I tour the dungeon and ask the monsters what they need.
In the afternoon I draw up a plan to turn one trap into an attraction.
In the evening I ask the monsters which adventurers they would welcome back.
story-019.b: I check the books for what the dungeon owes.
story-019.c: I ask the bank how to renegotiate the inheritance.

t: In the morning I examine the commander's wounds before anyone else sees them.
In the afternoon I ask the guards why the commander must live.
At night I ask the commander who taught him the healing he carries.
story-020.b: I ask what the commander knows about my kingdom's forbidden magic.
story-020.c: I treat the wound and note exactly where the magic leads.

t: In the morning I ask the princess why she hired me when she knows I am a fraud.
In the afternoon I ask the princess what journey no real knight would accept.
In the evening I practice with a real sword and ask the princess to correct me.
story-021.b: I ask what she needs from a fake knight.
story-021.c: I admit who I am and ask her to tell me the whole plan.

t: At dawn I step into the tea shop and ask what each cup removes.
In the afternoon I ask the owner what she remembers from the loops.
At night I ask her to pour the tea I have not tried yet.
story-022.b: I ask her which future she wants me to keep.
story-022.c: I look for what changes between each loop.

t: In the morning I open the suitcase and ask the tiny citizens what they need.
In the afternoon I ask the guardians where the kingdom's border is missing.
At night I hide the suitcase and watch who is searching the street.
story-023.b: I ask who built the kingdom and why it was left behind.
story-023.c: I follow the full-sized army to see what they are looking for.

t: In the morning I unroll the blank scroll and read it again in daylight.
In the afternoon I ask Nyx what lie we should tell first.
At night I ask Nyx why we trusted a blank scroll.
story-024.b: I test one small lie and watch if it becomes true.
story-024.c: I ask who sealed the prophecy in the first place.

t: In the morning I clean the sword and ask why it rejects every hero.
In the afternoon I ask the sword who the next hero will be.
At night I ask the sword how I can break it before the coronation.
story-025.b: I ask the priests what they know about the sword's warning.
story-025.c: I take the sword out of the hall and keep it hidden.

t: At breakfast I ask Nina what happens in the chapter she wrote last night.
In the afternoon I read a page of her manuscript and check it against the day.
In the evening I ask Nina how the chapter ends.
story-026.b: I ask whether she writes the ending or finds it.
story-026.c: I suggest we write the next page together.

t: On the morning platform I look for the stranger and return the umbrella.
In the afternoon I leave a note for the stranger at the station.
On the last train I sit beside them and ask about the transfer.
story-027.b: I ask when the transfer takes effect.
story-027.c: I offer to keep the ritual going in another place.

t: In the morning I walk into the flower shop and ask Jun about the wedding commission.
In the afternoon I put the sketches on the counter and ask for his honest opinion.
In the evening I stay after closing and bring up the apology.
story-028.b: I ask which flowers he would refuse to use.
story-028.c: I propose we split the commission by who knows the couple better.

t: In the morning I water my plants and leave a note on the rail for Leah.
In the afternoon I read the demolition notice and ask Leah what she plans to do.
In the evening I ask Leah to meet me in the courtyard.
story-029.b: I ask the neighbours who else received the notice.
story-029.c: I suggest a petition and ask Leah to co-sign.

t: In the morning I check the forecast and bring two umbrellas to the kiosk.
In the afternoon I ask Iris to show me what she is restoring.
In the evening rain I ask Iris when she plans to leave the city.
story-030.b: I ask Iris what she will miss most about the city.
story-030.c: I take a photograph of the kiosk and show her.

t: In the morning I read the delayed letter and recognise the handwriting.
In the afternoon I visit the post office and ask Eli why he said it was never meant to be delivered.
In the evening I ask Eli what the letter was supposed to say.
story-031.b: I ask who he wrote it for and why it was held.
story-031.c: I reply to the letter at the counter.

t: In the morning I open the secondhand book and read the first note in the margin.
In the afternoon I ask Mina where the book came from.
In the evening I follow the margin notes to the next bookshelf.
story-032.b: I ask when the bookshop will close.
story-032.c: I write a note in the margin to the stranger.

t: In the morning I rehearse our story with my fake date before the family arrives.
In the afternoon I ask Claire how she knows every detail about me.
In the evening I step away from the reunion and ask her the truth.
story-033.b: I ask how long she has been paying attention.
story-033.c: I change one detail and watch how she reacts.

t: In the morning at the studio I replay the unfinished song and ask Rae how it should begin.
In the afternoon I ask Rae what ending she wants.
At night I ask Rae to sing the part she cannot finish.
story-034.b: I ask what split the band apart.
story-034.c: I record a rough take and let her listen.

t: In the morning rush I read the name on my cup and ask the barista who it is for.
In the afternoon I ask Alex about the customer with the wrong cup.
In the evening I stay after closing and ask what the shared dream is.
story-035.b: I ask the barista to write my real name this time.
story-035.c: I tell the other customer about the mix-up.

t: In the endless dark I follow the sunbeam to its source.
In the afternoon lamp round I ask Sol who benefits from the night.
At night I carry the sunbeam home and ask what it wants.
story-036.b: I ask the other lamplighters whether they have seen it.
story-036.c: I hide the sunbeam from the officials.

t: In the morning I check the register and ask the manager about Room 404.
In the afternoon I ask Vera why there is no fourth floor.
At night I wait for Thursday's guest at the front desk.
story-037.b: I look up the last guest who stayed in Room 404.
story-037.c: I ask Vera to show me the key to the room.

t: In the morning I clean the glass and ask the saint what she wants.
In the afternoon I ask Alma how the saint cures the city.
At night I look in the mirror to find who stands in her reflection.
story-038.b: I ask who stood where the reflection should be.
story-038.c: I ask what happens if I refuse.

t: In the morning I record yesterday and compare it with the photographs.
In the afternoon I ask Ash which edits he remembers.
In the evening I replay my recordings and look for what changed.
story-039.b: I ask my trusted friend how they noticed the edits.
story-039.c: I hide a note where only I will find it.

t: At dawn I return the lost objects and ask what they remember.
In the afternoon I study the wedding ring and its date.
At midnight I read the warning addressed to me.
story-040.b: I ask the previous clerk how the objects find their owners.
story-040.c: I ask Wren who lost the wedding ring.

t: In the morning I audit the contract's first witness.
In the afternoon I ask my shadow why it sold a year of my life.
At night I search the contract for a clause I can use.
story-041.b: I ask which witness disappeared most recently.
story-041.c: I ask the buyer what they intend to do with the year.

t: In the morning I develop the portrait again and check the subject's face.
In the afternoon I ask Silas to identify the stranger.
At night I follow the portrait's address and watch the house.
story-042.b: I ask who ordered the portrait.
story-042.c: I warn the stranger without revealing the photograph.

t: In the morning I inspect the bell tower and ask Nell about the rule.
In the afternoon I ask Nell about the friend who disappeared.
At night I wait for the second bell and decide whether to answer.
story-043.b: I ask who rang the bell before.
story-043.c: I seal the tower door before the second bell.

t: In the morning I walk through the empty exhibit and ask the curator why it is empty.
In the afternoon I ask Ivo who is living my abandoned futures.
In the evening I ask to see the exhibit of someone else's life.
story-044.b: I ask how the curator knows which lives were abandoned.
story-044.c: I ask to speak with the person living my future.

t: In the morning I search the market for the angel on the poster.
In the afternoon I ask Seren who the stolen prayers belonged to.
At night I find the angel and ask for her side.
story-045.b: I ask who posted the bounty.
story-045.c: I ask which stolen wish matters most to the kingdom.

t: In the morning I check on the nameless patient in my clinic.
In the afternoon I ask Yun what he remembers first.
At night I ask Yun to look at the mountain and say what returns.
story-046.b: I ask what the old enemy would do if he learned of him.
story-046.c: I keep the patient hidden from the villagers.

t: In the morning I wipe the teahouse counter and listen to the sword hum.
In the afternoon I ask the guest what story he wants to hear.
At night I ask Shen why the sword woke after ten years.
story-047.b: I ask the guest why this story matters.
story-047.c: I serve the guest tea and wait for him to speak.

t: In the morning I sort the letters addressed to the moon.
In the afternoon I ask the village elder who sent the first letter.
At night I write a reply under the moonlight.
story-048.b: I ask the courier who taught her to read the moon.
story-048.c: I ask the exiled celestial what she needs from a human.

t: In the morning I walk down to the lowest village and ask who recognises me.
In the afternoon I ask the elder what promise my previous life made.
At night I climb to the shrine and ask the mountain directly.
story-049.b: I ask the villagers what they owe the mountain.
story-049.c: I look for the record of my previous life.

t: In the morning I greet the fox spirit and ask what favor she means.
In the afternoon I ask Su why she arrived now.
In the evening I warn her about the town's decision.
story-050.b: I ask which spirits are in danger.
story-050.c: I speak to the town elders on her behalf.
